glade_whisper.name: The Glade's Whisper
glade_whisper.summary: Elder Maelin says the mosslings no longer sleep. Something under the roots is dreaming them awake.

hollow_roots.name: What Sleeps Beneath
hollow_roots.summary: The corruption has a source. Elder Maelin believes it is the Hollowed Guardian at the edge of the glade.

steps.text: Tell Elder Maelin what you found

elder_memory.name: The First Tree Remembers
elder_memory.summary: The Hollowed Guardian's heart points toward the oldest tree in Greenward. Find the Elder Hollow and learn what began the corruption.

steps.text: Return the First Tree's memory to Elder Maelin

matron_bloom.name: A Garden Without a Keeper
matron_bloom.summary: The Elder Hollow reveals that the corruption has a will of its own. Follow the trail to the Fallen Matron.

steps.text: Tell Elder Maelin the Matron has fallen

sera_caravan.name: A Merchant's Bad Luck
sera_caravan.summary: Sera's supply cart was driven off the road by thornhounds. Clear the path so her caravan can move again.

pip_whispers.name: Three Little Whispers
pip_whispers.summary: Pip has heard three glade wisps calling from the reeds. Find them before they lure another traveler off the path.

steps.text: Tell Pip the wisps are gone
